_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md — a checkpoint turn re-plans the tail. The planning turn proposes 4 checkpoints [cp1..cp4]. cp1 completes. cp2 completes AND passes revised_tail with 2 new steps -> plan.apply_checkpoint_done drops the still-pending cp3/cp4 and appends the new ones (still cp3/cp4 by position). The PlanWorkflow keeps walking: the new cp3 and cp4 complete. Exercises revised_tail replacing only the pending tail (cp1/cp2 untouched), and PLAN.md ending complete with the REVISED steps.

message.content: Add end-to-end request tracing across the gateway, the coordinator, and the tenant worker so we can follow one request through all three. Design it, wire it in, and verify a trace shows up.

checkpoints.intent: Pick a tracing library and propagation format
checkpoints.done_when: the library and the header format are chosen
the gateway starts a span and injects the trace header

checkpoint_responses.content: Chose OpenTelemetry with W3C traceparent propagation.

Instrumented the gateway. While wiring it I found the coordinator and the worker both already run inside one Temporal workflow context, so a single shared interceptor covers both instead of two separate passes — revising the rest of the plan.

arguments.note: coordinator + worker share a Temporal context — one interceptor, not two

revised_tail.intent: Add one Temporal interceptor that continues the span for both coordinator and worker activities
revised_tail.done_when: a workflow + its activities appear under the gateway's trace

revised_tail.intent: Run a request end-to-end and confirm one trace spans all three services
revised_tail.done_when: a single trace id shows gateway + coordinator + worker spans

checkpoint_responses.content: Added the Temporal interceptor; coordinator and worker spans now nest under the gateway span.
Sent a request through: one trace id, spans for gateway ingress, the coordinator workflow, and three worker activities. Done.
